Name: East Scarp Animals Retouched
Author: AirynS
Description:
This mod touches up the animal portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger[/url], and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks [/url]for improved saturation and shading and cleaner details. Initially made as a set of personal edits, Yri asked if they could be published and reached out to Lemurkat to obtain permission, so here they are.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

To install, extract the "East Scarp Animals Retouched" and move the "[CP] East Scarp Animals Retouched" folder into your Mods folder. Next, select either the "MunchingtonGold" [i]or[/i] the "MunchingtonWhite" folder, take the "East Scarp" folder from inside, and drop it either into your Mods folder or into the subfolder in which you have East Scarp. Allow it to overwrite. This step is necessary to replace Munchington's Custom Companions portraits, as these aren't currently CP-editable.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

This mod requires one or more of East Scarp, Mister Ginger, or Juliet and Jessie.

[b][size=4]Configuration [/size][/b]

This mod has two options:
[list]
[*]MunchingtonColour: Changes Aideen's cat Munchington to have white fur in his portraits matching his sprite or gold fur matching his original portraits. Currently does nothing as manual overwrite is required; see the installation instructions for details.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]LittleGruffColour: Changes Eyvind's goat Little Gruff to have black fur in his portraits matching his sprite or purple fur matching his original portraits.[/*]
[/list]
